spec.title: OpenTelemetry Traces Explorer
spec.description: Explore OpenTelemetry traces with service topology, per-service drill-downs, and trace search. Click services, operations, or TraceIds to navigate.

variables.name: database
variables.label: Database
variables.query: SELECT database FROM system.tables WHERE name IN ('otel_logs', 'otel_traces') GROUP BY database HAVING count(DISTINCT name) = 2 ORDER BY database

variables.name: service
variables.label: Service
variables.query: SELECT ServiceName FROM ${database}.otel_traces WHERE $__timeFilter(Timestamp) GROUP BY ServiceName ORDER BY count() DESC LIMIT 10

variables.name: operation
variables.label: Operation
variables.query: SELECT DISTINCT SpanName FROM ${database}.otel_traces WHERE $__timeFilter(Timestamp) AND $__conditionalAll(ServiceName IN (${service:singlequote}), $service) ORDER BY SpanName LIMIT 200

variables.name: status
variables.label: Status
variables.query: SELECT DISTINCT StatusCode FROM ${database}.otel_traces WHERE $__timeFilter(Timestamp) ORDER BY StatusCode

variables.name: min_duration
variables.label: Min Duration (ms)
variables.description: Filter to traces lasting at least this many milliseconds. Leave blank for no minimum.

variables.name: search
variables.label: Search
variables.description: Free-text search applied to SpanName (operation) on every trace panel. Use the Traces Explorer's Status filter for error-only views. Leave blank to disable.

panels.title: Service Map
panels.description: Cross-service call graph from parent-child span joins. Edge counts are calls between services; node arcs show success vs error fraction. Limited to top 30 services and top 50 edges.
panels.reason: Grafana panel type nodeGraph is not supported yet.

panels.title: Trace Search Results
panels.description: Recent traces matching the variable filters. Click a TraceId to view the trace.

queries.query:
SELECT
  TraceId,
  any(ServiceName) AS Service,
  any(SpanName) AS RootOperation,
  min(Timestamp) AS Time,
  max(Duration) AS Duration,
  count() AS Spans,
  anyIf(StatusCode, StatusCode IN ('Error', 'STATUS_CODE_ERROR')) AS Status
FROM ${database}.otel_traces
WHERE $__timeFilter(Timestamp)
  AND $__conditionalAll(ServiceName IN (${service:singlequote}), $service)
  AND $__conditionalAll(SpanName IN (${operation:singlequote}), $operation)
  AND $__conditionalAll(StatusCode IN (${status:singlequote}), $status)
  AND $__conditionalAll(positionCaseInsensitive(SpanName, '$search') > 0, $search)
GROUP BY TraceId
HAVING $__conditionalAll(max(Duration) >= toUInt64($min_duration) * 1000000, $min_duration)
ORDER BY Time DESC
LIMIT 200

panels.title: Duration Distribution
panels.description: Span duration distribution over time for $service, log-scale. Sampled at 1-in-500 spans for performance.

queries.query:
SELECT
  toStartOfInterval(Timestamp, INTERVAL $__interval_s second) AS time,
  Duration / 1000000 AS duration_ms
FROM ${database}.otel_traces
WHERE $__timeFilter(Timestamp)
  AND ServiceName IN (${service:singlequote}) AND $__conditionalAll(positionCaseInsensitive(SpanName, '$search') > 0, $search)
  AND cityHash64(SpanId) % 500 = 0
ORDER BY time

SELECT toStartOfInterval(Timestamp, INTERVAL $__interval_s second) AS time, count() AS Spans FROM ${database}.otel_traces WHERE $__timeFilter(Timestamp) AND ServiceName IN (${service:singlequote}) AND $__conditionalAll(positionCaseInsensitive(SpanName, '$search') > 0, $search) GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

SELECT toStartOfInterval(Timestamp, INTERVAL $__interval_s second) AS time, countIf(StatusCode IN ('Error', 'STATUS_CODE_ERROR')) AS Errors FROM ${database}.otel_traces WHERE $__timeFilter(Timestamp) AND ServiceName IN (${service:singlequote}) AND $__conditionalAll(positionCaseInsensitive(SpanName, '$search') > 0, $search) GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

SELECT
  toStartOfInterval(Timestamp, INTERVAL $__interval_s second) AS time,
  quantile(0.99)(Duration) / 1000000 AS p99_ms
FROM ${database}.otel_traces
WHERE $__timeFilter(Timestamp)
  AND ServiceName IN (${service:singlequote}) AND $__conditionalAll(positionCaseInsensitive(SpanName, '$search') > 0, $search)
GROUP BY time
ORDER BY time

SELECT toStartOfInterval(Timestamp, INTERVAL $__interval_s second) AS time, avg(Duration) / 1000000 AS "Avg Duration" FROM ${database}.otel_traces WHERE $__timeFilter(Timestamp) AND ServiceName IN (${service:singlequote}) AND $__conditionalAll(positionCaseInsensitive(SpanName, '$search') > 0, $search) GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

panels.title: Top Operations
panels.description: Operations for $service ranked by call count. Errors and Error % are colour-coded.

queries.query:
SELECT
  SpanName AS Operation,
  count() AS Count,
  countIf(StatusCode IN ('Error', 'STATUS_CODE_ERROR')) AS Errors,
  round(countIf(StatusCode IN ('Error', 'STATUS_CODE_ERROR')) / count() * 100, 2) AS "Error %",
  quantile(0.5)(Duration) AS P50,
  quantile(0.99)(Duration) AS P99,
  anyIf(if(StatusMessage != '', StatusMessage, SpanAttributes['http.status_code']), StatusCode IN ('Error', 'STATUS_CODE_ERROR')) AS "Top Error"
FROM ${database}.otel_traces
WHERE $__timeFilter(Timestamp)
  AND ServiceName IN (${service:singlequote}) AND $__conditionalAll(positionCaseInsensitive(SpanName, '$search') > 0, $search)
GROUP BY Operation
ORDER BY Count DESC
LIMIT 15
